description: Adult CAP (J18) with hepatic impairment. The fixture drug carries NO hepatic adjustment data, so the engine MUST raise HEPATIC_NO_DATA and downgrade the outcome to WARNING — hepatic impairment may never yield a silently clean recommendation. (A drug that DOES carry hepatic guidance is covered by the HEPATIC_ADJ_UNPARSED escalation regression tests: AVOID_IF_POSSIBLE + dose_is_patient_specific=false.)

provenance.author: clinical safety audit (hepatic pathway coverage)
provenance.source: Fixture data: amoxicillin.hepatic_adjustment=null. Missing hepatic data is a WARNING (Invariant #11), never a silent exclusion and never a silent clean result.
